title: Jaswant Nagar Cold Storage Pvt Ltd v. Appellate Authority Additional Commissioner
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Dinesh Pathak, J.; Chandra Kumar Rai, J.
disposition: Writ listed; realisation of assessment dues stayed pending hearing.
headnote: On a cold-storage consumer's writ against a s.126 demand and a Clause 6.8 appeal order, the Allahabad High Court held that the matter required consideration, listed it for counter, and stayed realisation of dues under the 4.5.2021 demand and 7.3.2024 appellate order. The stay was later extended till further orders. Merits were not decided.
facts: A cold-storage company challenged the Assessing Officer's 4.5.2021 demand as issued without s.126(1) of the Electricity Act, 2003 and Clause 6.8(c)(i) of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, and the 7.3.2024 appellate order as passed perfunctorily without Clause 6.8(d)(v). It had deposited 50% of the demanded dues when filing the appeal. The High Court listed the writ for counter and stayed realisation of the two orders; on the adjourned date, no counter having been filed, the stay was extended.

holding_units.holding: The writ challenging the Assessing Officer's 4.5.2021 demand (alleged non-compliance with s.126(1) EA 2003 and Clause 6.8(c)(i)) and the 7.3.2024 appellate order (alleged non-compliance with Clause 6.8(d)(v)) was held to require consideration. Realisation of electricity dues under those orders was stayed till the next listing and later extended till further orders. Merits were not decided.

not_decided.point: Whether the 4.5.2021 demand complied with s.126(1) of the Electricity Act, 2003 and Clause 6.8(c)(i) of the Supply Code, 2005
not_decided.note: Only the petitioner's submission was recorded; no merits finding.

not_decided.point: Whether the appellate order of 7.3.2024 complied with Clause 6.8(d)(v)
not_decided.note: Left open for hearing after counter.
